validation_method: strict nested GroupKFold teacher cross-fitting plus independent common fixed validation for portable no-E5 GRU; geometric raw-XGB/GRU blend uses sim=0.20 XGB and au=0.85 XGB; char20 terminal rule was independently rebuilt within every session fold and exact future-history labels override all learned fallback

sequence_fusion_noe5.gate: only not exact future-history recovered rows

student_training.full_refit: 12 epochs on all rows; global rich-GRU GroupKFold OOF soft targets used only during training
student_training.inference_contract: portable no-E5 NumPy GRU; no teacher probabilities or E5 embeddings at inference

strict_nested_outer_group_oof.protocol: 5 outer session folds; each student-train soft target is produced by a 4-fold E5 teacher fit wholly inside that outer train partition

strict_common_fixed_validation.teacher_contract: teacher soft targets for common-train are 5-fold cross-fitted within common-train only; fixed validation was excluded
strict_common_fixed_validation.note: The conservative sim=0.20/au=0.85 gate was selected because sim=0.25, although stronger on nested OOF, fell to 0.703788 on this independent fixed split.

terminal_prompt_char_rule.training_scope: all 70,000 train rows; one count per feature per row
terminal_prompt_char_rule.rule_policy: casefold Unicode word tokens; replace digit runs with <n>; pad each token with ^/$; emit internal char 3/4/5-grams; retain support>=20 and exactly one observed label; inference requires every fired retained rule to agree
terminal_prompt_char_rule.deployment_gate: Only if future-history recovery did not deterministically reveal an action AND the sample is the maximum supplied step of its session. Do not add a confidence gate or source/context rule.

joint_deployment_validation.protocol: The char20 outer-fold predictions were aligned with the strict nested-distillation outer-fold assignment; fixed char20 predictions were aligned by validation ID before applying the same terminal-only gate.
